segments.text: In 1943 in Singapore, Netaji took supreme command of the Indian National Army (Azad Hind Fauj) and established the Provisional Government of Azad Hind.
He reorganized the army and mobilized unprecedented patriotic and financial support from the Indian diaspora in Southeast Asia.
On July 4, 1944, at a massive rally of Indians in Burma, Netaji delivered one of history's most electrifying motivational speeches.
He gave the immortal declaration that stirred every Indian heart: 'Give me blood, and I shall give you freedom!'
